titulo: News and media: Reading a short news text and social posts

aula.objetivo: Read newspaper headlines and short news items, say where information comes from, report what the news says with the right verbs and understand social media posts and comments in Brazilian Portuguese.

sessao.titulo: Reading a short news text and social posts

blocos.titulo: How a news item is built, and the language of social posts
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: the first paragraph of a news item (called «lide») answers six questions: «quem?» (who), «o quê?» (what), «quando?», «onde?», «como?» and «por quê?». Find them first, then read the details. STEP 2: tenses. The preterite tells the events («reabriu», «visitaram»), the imperfect describes the background («havia», «era»), the present tells facts that remain true («a biblioteca funciona de segunda a sábado») and the future announces what is next («será inaugurada»). STEP 3: quotes. The reporter writes «disse», «afirmou» or «explicou» after a quote, with the subject after the verb: «…», disse a bibliotecária. STEP 4: social posts and comments use shortcuts. They are very common but belong to informal contexts only: «vc» (você), «tb» (também), «pq» (porque or por que), «blz» (beleza, OK), «msg» (mensagem), «kkkk» or «rs» (laughter, written, like «haha»). In a news article, in a formal e-mail or on a form, write the whole word. STEP 5: in Brazil «compartilhar» and «curtir» (to like) are used on social media, and «seguir» means to follow.
blocos.comparacao: English news also starts with the key facts («who, what, when, where»). The main difference is that in Portuguese the attribution often comes after the quote and with the verb first: «…», disse ela. In text messages, Brazilians write «kkkk» (the sound of laughing) where English speakers write «haha» or «lol».

erros.errado: Pq o jornal não publicou? (in an article)
erros.certo: Por que o jornal não publicou?
erros.motivo: Do not use text-message shortcuts in a formal or printed text.
After a quote, news writing normally puts the verb first and the subject after it.

erros.errado: Eu assisti a notícia no jornal.
erros.motivo: You read a news item («ler») in a newspaper and you watch a TV news programme («assistir ao telejornal»).

blocos.titulo: A news item: the library reopens
blocos.ru:
Biblioteca do bairro reabre com mais de 10 mil livros

Ontem, a Biblioteca Comunitária do Jardim das Flores reabriu as portas depois de dois anos de reforma. Segundo a prefeitura, o espaço agora tem salas de estudo, acesso à internet e uma área infantil com contação de histórias aos sábados.

A bibliotecária Helena Prado afirmou que a procura foi grande logo no primeiro dia: cerca de 300 pessoas visitaram o local. “Muitos estudantes vieram procurar um lugar tranquilo para estudar”, disse.

A biblioteca funciona de segunda a sábado, das 9h às 18h. Para fazer o cartão, basta apresentar um documento com foto e um comprovante de residência.
blocos.pt:
Neighborhood library reopens with more than 10,000 books

Yesterday, the Jardim das Flores Community Library reopened its doors after two years of renovation. According to the city administration, the space now has study rooms, internet access and a children's area with storytelling sessions on Saturdays.

The librarian Helena Prado said that demand was high on the very first day: about 300 people visited the place. “Many students came looking for a quiet place to study”, she said.

The library is open from Monday to Saturday, from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. To get a card, you just need to show an ID with a photo and a proof of address.

perguntas.pergunta: When did the library reopen, and after how long?
perguntas.resposta: Yesterday, after two years of renovation.

perguntas.pergunta: What does the library offer now?
perguntas.resposta: Study rooms, internet access and a children's area with storytelling on Saturdays.

perguntas.pergunta: Who is the source of the information about the new space, and who gave the quote?
perguntas.resposta: The city administration («a prefeitura») for the space; the librarian Helena Prado for the quote.

perguntas.pergunta: How many people visited on the first day, and why did many students come?
perguntas.resposta: About 300 people; students came looking for a quiet place to study.

perguntas.pergunta: What do you need to get a library card?
perguntas.resposta: A photo ID and a proof of address.

blocos.enunciado: Write a short social media post (two sentences and a caption) about an event in your city. Use at least one shortcut (such as «tb» or «kkkk»), then rewrite it in formal Portuguese without shortcuts.
Say aloud: one sentence with «segundo», one with «de acordo com» and one with «cerca de». Then name two things you can find in the first paragraph of a news item.
